basic_details.short_information: Central Agricultural University (CAU) OSD (Liaison) Notification 2026 has been released on 23 July 2026 on the official website of Central Agricultural University (CAU). A total of 1 vacancy has been announced through the CAU OSD (Liaison) Recruitment 2026.

qualification.education_qualification: Graduate with minimum 10 years of experience as Liaison Officer in Ministry of Central Government
qualification.details: Graduate with minimum 10 years of experience as Liaison Officer in Ministry of Central Government. Must possess experience of handling Imprest Account, release of funds, annual plan budget, Annual reports and Annual accounts in both Houses of Parliament.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CAU OSD (Liaison) Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 31-07-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CAU to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: CAU OSD (Liaison) Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Graduate with minimum 10 years of experience as Liaison Officer in Ministry of Central Government. Must possess experience of handling Imprest Account, release of funds, annual plan budget, Annual reports and Annual accounts in both Houses of Parliament.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CAU OSD (Liaison) Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 31-07-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CAU to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CAU OSD (Liaison) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the CAU OSD (Liaison) recruitment is 31st July 2026. It is advisable to submit your application well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this CAU recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment drive by the Central Agricultural University (CAU) is OSD (Liaison).

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the OSD (Liaison) post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the OSD (Liaison) post in the Central Agricultural University recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the OSD (Liaison) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the OSD (Liaison) post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 55,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum qualification required for the OSD (Liaison) post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is a Graduate degree with a minimum of 10 years of experience as a Liaison Officer in a Ministry of the Central Government.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the CAU OSD (Liaison) recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the OSD (Liaison) post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the OSD (Liaison) post will involve shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What type of job is this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at the Central Agricultural University.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Central Agricultural University located?
faq.answer: The Central Agricultural University is located in Imphal, Manipur.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the CAU OSD (Liaison) recruitment?
faq.answer: You can apply online through the official website of CAU. Ensure you fill out the application form correctly and upload all required documents before the last date.
